patches.title: Warrior COUNTER fix
patches.description: Fixes the Warrior's COUNTER skill.

patches.title: Enemy HP bars
patches.description: Shows HP bars above enemies in the field.

patches.title: Enemy Pathfinding Fix
patches.description: Actual enemy pathfinding, no more getting stuck behind walls or obstacles.
Rebalances equipment sets and their pieces.

patches.title: Four-digit UI display
patches.description: Lets the HUD show four-digit numbers.
When the blacksmith's three materials match a recipe, the fuse always uses that recipe (no more ~30% roll first). Other combinations are unchanged.

patches.title: Level cap 250
patches.description: Raises the level cap to 250, with a new EXP table.

patches.title: HP / MP leech
patches.description: Adds HP / MP leech.
Controls gold drops from the first drop slot.
Normal (tap A) attacks get the same accuracy as charge attacks.
Gives each character its own attribute caps.

patches.title: Persistent Archer and Dark Mage summons
patches.description: Archer and Dark Mage summons stay out permanently.
Lets you redistribute stat points.
Adjusts ring stats.

patches.title: Shared character warehouses (beta)
patches.description: Beta. Warehouse shared between characters, with several pages. Touches save data: back up your save first.
Soul Return revives you automatically when you die.
Lets you equip a ring in the soul slot.

patches.title: Stackable consumables
patches.description: Consumables stack in the bag and warehouse.
Fixes an overflow in status resistance.
Reworks the temple's soul fusion recipes.
Returning to town through the blue teleporter after a boss, or with an Angel Wing, refills HP and SP, like leaving the arena already does.

patches.title: Performance fix (WAITCNT)
patches.description: Runs the cartridge at the wait states the developers intended (the game reset them at boot), for less slowdown.

patches.title: Proper walk angles
patches.description: Makes diagonal movement happen at 45 degree angles instead of 27 degrees. Made by Nellified.
Adjusts weapon stats. Also renames "Combat Claw" to "Combat Knife" (it becomes a knife).
Lets you open the warehouse from the world map.
